question: How many people have received the Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar Award in 2021 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology is an award given by the Government of India to recognize outstanding contributions to science. It is considered one of the most prestigious awards in the country for scientific achievement.

 
• The award is named after Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar, the founder and first Director-General of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) in India.
 
• It is presented annually by the Prime Minister of India.
 
• The award recognizes scientists who have made exceptional contributions to any branch of science, including engineering, medical, agricultural, and mathematical sciences.
 
• Individuals of Indian origin engaged in research in any field of science and technology up to the age of 45 years are eligible for this award.
 
• The award consists of a citation, a plaque, and a cash prize.
 
• The cash prize is typically a significant amount, though the exact sum can vary.
 
• The Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar Prize is awarded for research contributions made primarily in India during the five years preceding the award.
 
• The selection process is rigorous and involves a panel of eminent scientists who evaluate the nominations.
 
• The award is usually announced in September each year.
 
• The number of awardees can vary from year to year, depending on the quality of nominations received.
 
• There's no fixed number of awards given each year.
 
• It's not uncommon for the award to be shared by multiple scientists in a particular category.
 
• The Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar Prize plays a vital role in promoting scientific excellence in India.
 
• It inspires young scientists to pursue careers in research and development.
 
• The award recognizes and celebrates the achievements of Indian scientists who are making significant contributions to their respective fields.
